definitions: Physical currency (coins and banknotes) issued by a government or central bank, as opposed to digital or cryptocurrency.
A system of exchange using tangible forms of currency that have historical precedent and are widely accepted within an economy.
examples: Many people still prefer to use traditional money for daily transactions.
The rise of digital payments has reduced the reliance on traditional money.
She keeps her traditional money in a wallet.
Some businesses only accept traditional money.
